evals.prompt: Invoke $html-output-viewer and turn my 12-section implementation plan in notes/platform-migration.md into a self-contained HTML document I can review offline.
evals.expected_output: A readable offline HTML file that preserves the plan and provides navigation for its sections.
expectations: The output is a single HTML file with no remote scripts, stylesheets, fonts, or other network dependencies.
The rendered content preserves every source section and creates navigation links for headings.
The workflow uses scripts/render_html.py and reuses assets/reader-template.html instead of generating a new design.

evals.prompt: Use html-output-viewer for the architecture analysis you just wrote. Keep the tables, code snippets, and checklist intact, and call the result architecture-review.html.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained architecture-review.html artifact preserving tables, fenced code, and task lists.
expectations: Markdown tables render as HTML tables, fenced code renders as escaped code blocks, and checklist state is preserved.
The source wording is not summarized or rewritten during conversion.

evals.prompt: Write a detailed rollout plan in the chat, but do not invoke any artifact or HTML skill.
evals.expected_output: A normal conversational response; html-output-viewer must not trigger because it was not explicitly invoked.
expectations: The html-output-viewer skill is not loaded or used.
